text: dsh-soul-md 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的人设与长期记忆插件。它通过系统提示词区段注入当前人设和记忆，并在插件设置页及会话界面提供管理和切换能力。用户可按工作区或会话选择人设卡；Agent 可通过工具读取和更新人设、追加或重写分层记忆，并按关键词查找主题记忆。记忆按 core 与 topics 文件组织，支持提示词预算、子代理注入控制和压缩后的主题恢复。适合希望在不同项目保持稳定角色与可维护长期上下文的 DSH 用户；不需要额外 API 密钥，记忆文件由插件存于 DSH_HOME。

dsh-soul-md adds persona cards and long-term memory to DSH Web and Desktop. Set personas per workspace or session; the agent maintains core and topic files. Features include keyword search, prompt limits, subagent controls, and compaction recall. Memory stays under DSH_HOME; no API key is needed.
想给 DSH 的 Agent 配置可以随时切换的人设卡。
我希望每个工作区默认使用不同的角色设定。
怎么让某个会话临时关闭或更换人设？
想让 Agent 把长期信息保存成可编辑的本地记忆文件。
需要按主题查找记忆，并只在相关时提示摘要。
会话压缩后，怎样找回之前用过的记忆主题？
希望不同人设可以单独禁用长期记忆。
如何避免把人设和记忆自动注入到子代理提示词？
I want different default personas for separate workspaces.
Can an agent keep editable long-term notes in local files?
I need keyword search across topic memories and compact summaries in context.
How can I switch or disable a persona for one conversation?
dsh-soul-md 的功能「persona」：人设卡可以在会话或工作区中切换。插件设置页创建和编辑 Markdown 人设卡，并可设默认卡；会话选择优先于工作区映射和默认卡。
dsh-soul-md 的功能「memory」：以 core 和 topics 文件管理长期记忆。记忆工具按当前人设或全局范围读写文件；分层模式将常驻 core 与主题文件分开。
dsh-soul-md 的功能「recall」：本地关键词检索主题记忆。memory_search 对主题键、标题、摘要和全文做本地词面匹配，返回摘要以供 memory_read 核验。
dsh-soul-md 的功能「prompt」：控制提示词中的记忆注入。可关闭注入、设置字符预算及索引模式；超出预算时保留索引或记忆首尾并提示工具读取全文。
dsh-soul-md 的功能「recovery」：压缩后恢复近期查阅主题。成功压缩后，在下一用户回合提供曾查阅主题的描述，提示 Agent 重新读取记忆。
dsh-soul-md 的功能「subagent」：控制子代理的人设与记忆区段。默认不向委派子代理渲染人设和记忆提示词区段，可通过设置允许继承。
dsh-soul-md 使用前须知：长期记忆保存在 DSH_HOME 下的 soul-md/memory 目录；插件按需创建并读写 core 与 topics 文件。（见 index.js:39-40）
dsh-soul-md 使用前须知：主题检索基于本地关键词而非语义搜索；返回摘要，需再调用 memory_read 查看全文。（见 memory-recall.js:1-9）

dsh-soul-md README · DSH Soul / Persona：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 添加可切换的人设卡和文件式长期记忆。你可以为不同工作区或会话选择人设，让 Agent 按需读取、写入记忆，并在使用工具时更新人设。

dsh-soul-md README · 功能：- **人设卡**：在插件页创建、编辑并设置默认卡片；在新会话页或聊天标题栏为单个会话选择卡片，也可以在插件页隐藏选择器。
- **工作区人设**：为工作区指定默认卡片。解析顺序为：会话选择 → 工作区人设 → 默认卡 → 不启用。
- **文件记忆**：Agent 可使用 `memory_read`、`memory_append`、`memory_rewrite` 读取和维护记忆；`soul_read`、`soul_update` 用于读取和更新人设卡。
- **分层记忆**：默认将常驻 `core.md` 与按主题读取的 `topics/*.md` 分开，支持 `memory_search`、关键词召回和压缩后补偿，也可按需关闭。
- **按人设控制记忆**：每张卡默认启用记忆，可在插件页单独关闭，不影响人设本身。
- **子代理控制**：默认不向子代理自动注入人设和记忆；这不会改变记忆工具的读写作用域，可在设置中恢复注入。
dsh-soul-md README · 功能：Soul 的记忆以文件和人设为中心；需要对话捕获、模型提取和向量召回时，可另看 [DSH TDAI Memory](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-tdai-memory)。两个插件可独立使用。

dsh-soul-md README · 兼容性与安装：支持 DSH Web / Desktop；仓库声明兼容 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2` / `rc.3` / `rc.4` / `rc.5` 和符合 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` 的版本，预发布版本范围见 [package.json](package.json)。要求 Node.js `>=20.18`。

DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 没有新会话页的扩展位，可继续使用会话标题栏选择人设。

Desktop 先在 **应用 → 管理 dsh 命令** 安装桌面版 `dsh`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-soul-md
```

Web 将 `desktop` 改为 `web`。安装后重启 DSH，打开 **插件 → 已安装 → dsh-soul-md**。也可通过 [Enhancement Suite](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-enhancement-suite) 安装。

dsh-soul-md README · 快速使用：1. 在插件页创建人设卡，填写名称和 Markdown 内容并保存。
2. 设为默认卡，或为指定工作区配置卡片；也可在新会话页或聊天标题栏单独切换会话人设。切换工作区可能打开另一个空白会话，请检查该会话的人设选择。
3. 与 Agent 对话，让它按需使用记忆或人设工具。人设变化和记忆写入取决于模型的实际工具调用，不保证自动发生。
4. 分层记忆、关键词自动召回和压缩后补偿默认开启，可在设置中分别调整。

dsh-soul-md README · 记忆与设置：| 设置 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showPersonaSwitcher` | `true` | 显示新会话页和聊天标题栏的人设选择器；隐藏不会更改已有的会话选择 |
| `memory.inject` | `true` | 将记忆段落注入提示词 |
| `memory.disabledCards` | `[]` | 关闭记忆的人设卡名称列表；可通过插件页卡片旁的开关修改 |
| `memory.layered` | `true` | 启用 core + topics 分层，可关闭切回单文件模式 |
| `memory.recall` | `keyword` | 从插件运行期间的第二条用户消息起提示相关主题，可设为 `off` 关闭 |
| `memory.recallPlacement` | `context` | 动态召回默认放入运行时上下文；可设为 `system` 使用系统提示词 |
| `memory.indexMode` | `all` | 在关键词召回开启时可设为 `recall`，避免每轮注入完整主题索引 |
| `memory.compactionRecall` | `true` | 成功压缩或裁剪后，在下一用户回合提示近期使用过的主题摘要 |
| `memory.injectMaxChars` | `8000` | 记忆注入的字符预算 |
| `allowTemplates` | `false` | 是否解析人设与记忆中的提示词变量；默认保留花括号原文 |
| `skipSubagents` | `true` | 跳过对子代理的人设和记忆注入；设为 `false` 可让子代理继承 |

dsh-soul-md README · 记忆与设置：在插件页的人设卡列表中关闭某张卡的「记忆」后，该卡不再注入或召回记忆，四个 `memory_*` 工具也会拒绝调用，不会改用全局记忆。由该会话派生的子代理和团队成员同样受此限制；`soul_read` 和 `soul_update` 不受影响。已有记忆文件会保留，重新启用后可继续使用。工具名称仍可能显示在工具列表中；如果没有选择人设卡，仍使用全局记忆。

关闭开关不会删除已在当前会话历史中的记忆内容、运行时上下文快照或工具结果；需要隔离这些内容时，请新建会话。

dsh-soul-md README · 记忆与设置：关键词检索是字面匹配，并非语义向量搜索；召回提示只包含主题 key 与摘要，全文仍需通过工具读取，且受注入预算限制。启用召回且存在主题时，插件会在总预算内稳定预留最多四分之一给动态召回，避免长 core 挤掉召回，也避免每轮改变系统提示词。默认保留完整主题索引，方便模型发现没有字面命中的主题；主题很多时可切换到 `recall` 索引模式以减少常驻内容。运行时上下文使用 user 消息快照；若宿主禁用或不支持运行时上下文，会回退到系统提示词。旧快照可能在压缩前保留在对话历史中。`topic: "core"` 或 `"core.md"` 指向常驻 core；已有 `topics/core.md` 不会自动迁移，请先备份并核对后再手动整理。

显式保存的设置仍按原值生效；未设置的选项使用新默认值。分层模式会读取已有的单文件记忆，并在首次向 core 追加时保留其原有内容。

人设配置保存在当前 Profile；记忆默认位于 `$DSH_HOME/soul-md/memory/`。请按个人需要备份和管理这些文件。界面语言跟随 DSH。

dsh-soul-md README · DSH Soul / Persona：[简体中文](README.md) | English

Add switchable persona cards and file-based long-term memory to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Choose personas per workspace or session, and let the Agent read and write memory or update a persona through its tools.

dsh-soul-md README · Features：- **Persona cards:** create, edit and set a default card in the plugin page; select a persona for a session on the new-session page or in the conversation header, or hide the selectors in plugin settings.
- **Workspace personas:** assign a default card to a workspace. Resolution order is session selection → workspace persona → default card → disabled.
- **File memory:** the Agent can use `memory_read`, `memory_append` and `memory_rewrite`; `soul_read` and `soul_update` read and update persona cards.
- **Layered memory:** separate a resident `core.md` from on-demand `topics/*.md`, with `memory_search`, keyword recall and post-compaction recall enabled by default; each can be turned off.
- **Per-persona memory:** memory is enabled for each card by default and can be turned off independently without disabling the persona.
- **Subagent control:** skip automatic persona and memory injection for subagents by default without changing the memory tools' scope; inheritance can be enabled in settings.

dsh-soul-md README · Features：Soul centers memory on files and personas. For conversation capture, model-based extraction and vector recall, see [DSH TDAI Memory](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-tdai-memory). The plugins can be used independently.

dsh-soul-md README · Compatibility and installation：Supports DSH Web / Desktop. The repository declares compatibility with `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2` / `rc.3` / `rc.4` / `rc.5` and versions matching `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`; see [package.json](package.json) for the complete prerelease range. Node.js `>=20.18` is required.

DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` does not have the new-session extension slot; use the conversation header selector there.

For Desktop, install its `dsh` command through **Application → Manage dsh Command** first:

dsh-soul-md README · Compatibility and installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-soul-md
```

Replace `desktop` with `web` for Web. Restart DSH and open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-soul-md**. You can also install it through the [Enhancement Suite](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-enhancement-suite).

dsh-soul-md README · Quick start：1. Create a persona card in the plugin page, enter a name and Markdown content, and save it.
2. Set it as the default or assign it to a workspace; the new-session page and chat header can override the persona for one session. Switching workspaces can open another blank session, so check that session's selection.
3. Talk to the Agent and let it use memory or persona tools as needed. Persona updates and memory writes depend on actual model tool calls and are not guaranteed to happen automatically.
4. Layered memory, keyword recall and post-compaction recall are enabled by default and can be adjusted independently in settings.

dsh-soul-md README · Memory and settings：| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showPersonaSwitcher` | `true` | Show the new-session and conversation-header selectors; hiding them preserves existing session choices |
| `memory.inject` | `true` | Inject the memory section into the prompt |
| `memory.disabledCards` | `[]` | Persona card names with memory disabled; use the switch beside each card in the plugin page |
| `memory.layered` | `true` | Enable core + topics; turn off for single-file memory |
| `memory.recall` | `keyword` | Suggest related topics starting with the second user message processed during this plugin run; set to `off` to disable |
| `memory.recallPlacement` | `context` | Put changing recall in runtime context by default; choose `system` for the system prompt |
| `memory.indexMode` | `all` | With keyword recall enabled, `recall` avoids injecting the full topic index every turn |
| `memory.compactionRecall` | `true` | After successful compaction or trimming, suggest recently used topic summaries on the next user turn |
| `memory.injectMaxChars` | `8000` | Character budget for memory injection |
| `allowTemplates` | `false` | Resolve prompt variables

dsh-soul-md README · Memory and settings：Turn off **Memory** beside a persona card to stop memory injection and recall for that card. All four `memory_*` tools reject calls instead of falling back to global memory, including from delegated subagents and team members. `soul_read` and `soul_update` still work. Memory files are kept and become available again when memory is re-enabled. Tool names may still appear in the tool list. Sessions with no persona card continue to use global memory.

dsh-soul-md README · Memory and settings：Turning memory off does not remove content already present in the current conversation history, runtime-context snapshots or tool results. Start a new session to isolate those earlier contents.

dsh-soul-md README · Memory and settings：Keyword search is lexical, not semantic vector search. Recall supplies topic keys and summaries only; full text requires a tool read, and the injection budget still applies. With recall enabled and topics present, up to one quarter of the total budget is reserved for dynamic recall, so a long core does not crowd it out and the system prefix remains stable. The full topic index remains enabled by default so the model can discover topics without a lexical match; with many topics, `recall` index mode reduces resident content. Runtime context uses user-message snapshots. If the host disables or does not support runtime context, recall falls back to the system prompt. Older snapshots may remain in conversation history until compaction. `topic: "core"` or `"core.md"` targets resident core; existing `topics/core.md` is not moved automatically. Back it up and inspect it before manually reorganizing.

dsh-soul-md README · Memory and settings：Explicitly saved settings keep their values; options not set use the new defaults. Layered memory reads existing single-file memory and preserves its contents when first appending to core.

Persona settings live in the current profile; memory defaults to `$DSH_HOME/soul-md/memory/`. Back up and manage those files as needed. The interface follows the DSH language setting.
